name: off-topic
description:
The distance of each phrase of the core from the centre of the core, by meaning.

threshold: the similarity from 0 to 1 a phrase needs to the centre to be on topic.

The centre is the mean of the phrase vectors of the core, each weighed by its frequency with freq and by 1 without it; with seed, the mean of the phrase vectors of the seed phrases. The columns: off_topic_score (1 minus the similarity of the phrase to the centre, from 0 to 1, 4 places) and off_topic (yes when the similarity is below the threshold, else no); an empty cell gets none. No row is dropped.

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" off-topic write -
-> купить диван, 0.0, no

model: the encoder, pulled once with `semkit models pull NAME`: e5-small, bge-m3, potion, or hf:<id> of a model of the Hugging Face hub. Without --threshold the step takes the threshold of the model; a hub model has none.
freq: the column of the frequencies of the phrases in the current table; the centre of the core weighs each phrase by it. Without it, every phrase weighs the same.
seed: the phrases whose centre is the topic, in place of the core: a list of your own as @FILE or @NAME, or comma-separated.

The step adds the columns off_topic_score and off_topic right after the working column; the rows stay.

options.name: --threshold
options.description: the similarity from 0 to 1 a phrase needs to the centre to be on topic.

options.name: --freq
options.description: the column of the frequencies of the phrases in the current table; the centre of the core weighs each phrase by it. Without it, every phrase weighs the same.

options.name: --seed
options.description: the phrases whose centre is the topic, in place of the core: a list of your own as @FILE or @NAME, or comma-separated. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.
